env_seed_rule: LIBERO env seed = 142 + init_state (paper code IRVLUTD/LLM_LIBERO tasks.py ENV_SEED_BASE); 10 no-op settle steps after set_init_state
note: Episodes are (task_id, init_state) pairs of LIBERO's 50 fixed init states per task. A split's episodes may be attempted only by sessions serving that split (playgrounds/libero/server.py reset). Scored episodes are attempted once per (run, actor). Outcomes on scored and feasibility splits are never reported to the actor.

feasibility.purpose: Argon attempt-1 feasibility check of the published protocol [llm-libero-2026], 1 episode per task. Never scored, never reused as a scored or practice episode.
feasibility.draw: numpy.random.default_rng(20261025).integers(10, 50) once per task, in task order, from init states 10-49 (0-9 are the scored split)

scored.purpose: The paper's protocol: init states 0-9 of every LIBERO-10 task, 100 episodes, one attempt each per (run, actor). The same 100 episodes as the published campaign, so attempt 1, attempt N and the paper's per-episode Argon-high outcomes are paired.

smoke.status: scripted install checks only, no brain

unassigned: LIBERO-10 init states 10-48 not listed above stay unassigned (kept clean for later scored repeats). LIBERO-90 (all 90 tasks x 50 init states) is the practice pool; a practice split will be declared before the first practice run.
